name: glyhub_GPST000120_O_Spike_ACE2
title: Released O-glycans of recombinant SARS-CoV-2 Spike and ACE2
description: The study characterizes the glycosylation of recombinant Spike and soluble human ACE2. This complete source O-glycan table reports percent of total profile for 16 glycan features in each protein preparation. Columns are protein-level profiles, not biological replicates.
details: The entire 16-feature source O-glycan table is retained. The two columns are protein-level profiles for recombinant Spike and soluble human ACE2, with no biological replicate identity inferred. Original nd/nd* markers and measurements are retained; abundance zeros and not-detected entries are represented as NA without renormalization.
